svg.title: ProofBerry AI — Staffing Pilot Fit Card
svg.desc: Buyer qualification card for a one-role ProofBerry staffing design-partner pilot.

g.text: A low-friction qualification card for staffing and recruiting teams.
A STRONG EARLY DESIGN-PARTNER FIT HAS:
✓ One live role with clear client expectations
✓ A real need to make candidate capability easier to inspect
✓ A small candidate cohort the recruiter can review normally
✓ Willingness to compare today’s handoff with an evidence packet
✓ A human recruiter / client who keeps the consequential decision
✓ Permission to learn from the workflow — not from sensitive identity data
One role. One client workflow. Small cohort.
Ask one question: did the client handoff become easier to review?
No rip-and-replace. No automatic hiring. No outcome guarantee.
Illustrative early-access pilot concept. ProofBerry organizes role-relevant evidence for review; human teams retain hiring decisions.
